papers.title: From Skills to Talent: Organising Heterogeneous Agents as a Real-World Company
papers.abstract: OneManCompany (OMC) introduces an organizational framework for multi-agent systems that enables dynamic team assembly, governance, and improvement through portable agent identities called Talents and hierarchical decision-making processes.

papers.title: ReVSI: Rebuilding Visual Spatial Intelligence Evaluation for Accurate Assessment of VLM 3D Reasoning
papers.abstract: ReVSI addresses flaws in current spatial intelligence evaluation by creating a validated benchmark with improved annotations and controlled frame sampling conditions for vision-language models.

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action Safety: Threats, Challenges, Evaluations, and Mechanisms
papers.abstract: Survey of safety challenges in Vision-Language-Action models covering threats from data poisoning to adversarial attacks, requiring unified approaches across multiple domains for secure deployment.

papers.title: Tuna-2: Pixel Embeddings Beat Vision Encoders for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract: Tuna-2 is a unified multimodal model performing visual understanding and generation directly from pixel embeddings without pretrained vision encoders, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

papers.title: ClawMark: A Living-World Benchmark for Multi-Turn, Multi-Day, Multimodal Coworker Agents
papers.abstract: Benchmark for evaluating language-model agents in multi-day collaborative workflows with evolving environmental states across multiple service domains like email, calendar, and spreadsheets.

papers.title: Efficient Agent Evaluation via Diversity-Guided User Simulation
papers.abstract: DIVERT is a coverage-guided user simulation framework that efficiently evaluates large language models by reusing conversation prefixes and exploring diverse interaction paths through branching trajectories.

papers.title: For-Value: Efficient Forward-Only Data Valuation for finetuning LLMs and VLMs
papers.abstract: For-Value framework efficiently estimates data value using final hidden representations and prediction errors, enabling scalable batch processing without gradient computations for LLMs and VLMs.

papers.title: OmniShotCut: Holistic Relational Shot Boundary Detection with Shot-Query Transformer
papers.abstract: OmniShotCut formulates shot boundary detection as structured relational prediction using a shot query-based dense video Transformer with synthetic transition generation and comprehensive benchmark.

papers.title: Taming Actor-Observer Asymmetry in Agents via Dialectical Alignment
papers.abstract: Large language model agents exhibit cognitive bias in error attribution; ReTAS framework uses dialectical reasoning to promote perspective-invariant decision making in multi-agent systems.

papers.title: Stabilizing Efficient Reasoning with Step-Level Advantage Selection
papers.abstract: Step-level Advantage Selection addresses training instability in efficient reasoning by selectively adjusting confidence in reasoning steps, improving accuracy-efficiency trade-off in mathematical tasks.

cc_updates.body: Added `alwaysLoad` option to MCP server config for always-available tools. Added `claude plugin prune` to remove orphaned dependencies. Added type-to-filter search to `/skills`. PostToolUse hooks can now replace tool output. Fullscreen mode improvements: typing doesn't jump scroll, dialogs are scrollable, long URLs clickable. SDK supports `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1` in non-interactive sessions. Multiple bug fixes including memory leaks and MCP connection issues.

`/config` settings now persist to `~/.claude/settings.json`. Added `prUrlTemplate` setting for custom code-review URLs. Added `CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD` env variable. `--from-pr` accepts GitLab/Bitbucket URLs. `--print` mode honors agent's `tools:` and `disallowedTools:`. PowerShell tool commands can be auto-approved. Hooks include `duration_ms`. Multiple fixes for pasting, MCP OAuth, slash commands, and plugins.

Added vim visual mode (`v`) and visual-line mode (`V`). Merged `/cost` and `/stats` into `/usage`. Create custom themes from `/theme` or edit JSON in `~/.claude/themes/`. Hooks can invoke MCP tools via `type: "mcp_tool"`. Added `DISABLE_UPDATES` env var. Auto mode includes `"$defaults"` for custom rules. Multiple fixes for OAuth, MCP, themes, and performance.
